title: Robin holography in AdS and BTZ: double-trace RG flow and exceptional points
summary: We construct the exact Robin bulk-to-boundary propagator for a Breitenlöhner--Freedman scalar on AdS$_{d+1}$ and the BTZ black hole, realizing the double-trace RG flow between standard and alternate quantization geometrically as a one-parameter family of bulk boundary conditions.
